findings.title: More than one HPA controls the same pods
findings.cause: HPAs web-cpu and web-memory all scale Deployment web: the HPA controller does not act on pods that more than one HPA controls, so none of them scales it

evidence.what: HPA web-cpu has scaleTargetRef Deployment web
evidence.command: kubectl get hpa web-cpu -n kd-hpa-two-on-one-workload -o jsonpath='{.spec.scaleTargetRef}'

evidence.what: HPA web-memory has scaleTargetRef Deployment web
evidence.command: kubectl get hpa web-memory -n kd-hpa-two-on-one-workload -o jsonpath='{.spec.scaleTargetRef}'

evidence.detail: pods by selector app=web are controlled by more than one HPA (e.g. [kd-hpa-two-on-one-workload/web-cpu kd-hpa-two-on-one-workload/web-memory])

findings.fix: Keep one HPA for Deployment web and list every metric in it (an HPA with several metrics scales to the highest answer); delete the others.
